— Background: mid-market SaaS (customer support automation + knowledge workflows). Product team (Head of Product: Priya Rao) wants to replace/augment search + first-line chat triage. Currently using embeddings + simple BM25; latency/costs rising with growth.

— Engagement timeline (high level):
  • 2025-11-05: inbound interest — discovery call w/ AE (Eleanor) and Head of Engineering. initial scoping: 40k MAU, support chat / KB retrieval critical.
  • 2026-01-18: Hosted API demo (token streaming, function calls, embeddings). Product liked streaming + structured output.
  • 2026-02-10: Security pre-checks — sent SOC2 attestation + SSO docs.
  • 2026-02-24: POC kickoff — 2-week pilot using Hosted API for doc-search + ranking pipeline.
  • 2026-03-01: POC mid-point — found 180–220ms median latency for small chat samples; costs higher than expected at current batching settings.
  • 2026-03-09: Cost optimization workshop request (internal): want explicit unit-economics before Dedicated commit.
  • 2026-03-15: Scheduled cost optimization workshop + POC tuning (SE: Derek) — topics: batching, prefix/KV caching, quantization profile tradeoffs, model-routing policies, expected token/unit cost at target throughput.

— Requirements / success metrics (customer paraphrase):
  • "We need sub-200ms p95 for support chat end-to-end." (Priya Rao)
  • Throughput target: sustain 35–50 qps during peak (support spikes).
  • Embedding refresh cadence: nightly + on-demand incremental updates; storage/residency constraints for EU tenants.
  • Cost sensitivity: looking to reduce per-conversation token cost by ~40% vs current baseline to justify Dedicated commit.

— Technical notes / preferences:
  • Prefer starting on Hosted API for rapid iteration, then migrate selected models to Dedicated reserved pool for predictable latency/cost.
  • Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations: batching profiles (dynamic batch sizing), KV/prefix caching for repeated queries, mixed-precision/INT8 quantization profile comparison for Mistral/Redwood-verified models.
  • Routing policy: prefer cheaper model variant for non-sensitive requests; strict variants for PII/EU-resident data. Automatic fallback is required.
  • Integrations required: Okta SSO, AWS KMS for key management, audit log forwarding to Splunk.

— POC findings / questions we need answered in workshop:
  • Which batching configuration hits p95 <200ms for 32-token responses at 40 qps? (need numbers)
  • How much latency overhead does prefix/KV cache add for cold misses vs warm hits? (expectation: big win for repeated KB prompts)
  • Quantization: expected throughput improvement and model-quality delta for INT8 vs FP16 on Dedicated GPUs (per-token cost model).
  • Pricing: delta hosted -> dedicated per million tokens at planned throughput; burst vs reserved pricing examples.

— Commercial notes:
  • Initial ask: a 6–12 month Dedicated proposal with a 6-month ramp and optional burst credit.
  • Budget owner: VP Finance (Alex Mercer) needs clear ARR/COGS comparisons.
